purpose: Machine-readable contract connecting Rezef capabilities to knowledge, runtime evidence and safety gates.

status_vocabulary.implemented: Implemented and covered locally; production operation is a separate claim.
status_vocabulary.partial: Useful implementation exists, but the honest boundary prevents a complete claim.
status_vocabulary.gated: Implementation exists but configuration, consent, verification or owner action blocks operation.
status_vocabulary.blocked: A required product link is missing.
status_vocabulary.target: Required end-state with no complete implementation yet.

capabilities.system_of_record: SUMIT is authoritative for issued/received documents and the official books; Rezef stores normalized copies, workflow state and evidence.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Read synchronization and several document/payment actions exist. Scheduled detail enrichment claims a separate 20-hour budget before provider access, caps paid getdetails calls at 25 per org/day and reuses CustomerName from the list response. OCR stops before SUMIT while disabled; when enabled it claims a separate 20-hour budget and defaults to 10 documents with a hard cap of 25. The official-books createbatch adapter now consumes an immutable owner-approved payload, claims execution once, requires BatchURL and records executed_unverified. The versioned OpenAPI exposes neither batch readback nor close, so the adapter creates an open batch only and cannot prove posting/closure; portal verification and owner-only close remain external. Measured 2026-08-05: an organization silently drops out of the daily cron when its IntegrationConnection turns paused/inactive, because both scheduled_sync_sumit and roster_sync_targets select on status=='active' -- org2 was out for 467h and org3 for 762h with no error raised. roster_coverage now reports this per source (a healthy open_finance connection must not mask a paused sumit one) but deliberately does not reactivate anything: reconnecting a client file is an owner decision.
capabilities.next_gate: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN gate 3: operator-approved createbatch dry-run, portal readback evidence and owner-approved batch close.

capabilities.system_of_record: Open Finance is authoritative for bank/card observations; Rezef owns normalized transactions, reconciliation decisions and derived insights.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Client, normalization and an admin-only consent journey exist locally. Provider responses missing id/connectUrl/status fail closed, connection operations are checked against the local organization before provider access, and daily sync stops before its budget claim while tracked consent is pending. A company without owner-completed consent, valid provider scopes and a successful live sync still has no bank truth.
capabilities.next_gate: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN gate 0.3: connect the pilot company and prove daily account ingestion.

capabilities.system_of_record: Rezef orchestrates DB-first checks after cost-gated source ingestion.
capabilities.honest_boundary: The DB-first cycle, UTC-to-Israel schedule contract and a clean Alembic-to-head deployment are covered locally. The legacy schema path is SUPER_ADMIN-only, requires exact confirmation, repairs additive table/column gaps and then verifies types, nullability, primary/foreign keys, unique constraints and indexes before stamping head; partial DDL scripts never stamp head. SQLite-only FK exemptions are reported explicitly and never exempt PostgreSQL. SUMIT detail enrichment claims a separate 20-hour budget before provider access, is capped at 25 paid getdetails actions per org/day, and reuses free list fields. OCR is fail-closed while disabled and, when enabled, uses a separate 20-hour claim with a default limit of 10 and hard cap of 25 documents. This does not prove that the cron, schema and both integrations are deployed and healthy for a pilot company.
capabilities.next_gate: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN gate 0.1: owner-approved deployment and production smoke; then gate 4.1 requires seven consecutive pilot days with a verified brief by 08:00.

capabilities.title_he: קליטת מסמכים, OCR, סיווג ותיוק הוצאות
capabilities.system_of_record: Raw source document remains evidence; Rezef owns extracted fields and decisions; SUMIT owns the final filed expense.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Classification and filing paths exist, but ambiguous documents, missing vehicle profiles and unsupported evidence must remain in review rather than be auto-filed. Measured in production 2026-08-05: 415 of the pending SUMIT drafts carry total=0 (org1 243, org2 16, org5 156) because the API returns an empty draft envelope -- the readable receipt lives behind the app.sumit.co.il session, so no key-based pipeline can extract them. Only the 41 'sumit_fileexpense' rows for org5 (ILS 211,107.98) carry real amounts. 1,200 of 1,491 expenses have no supplier_tax_id, which blocks registry verification and a correct PCN874 base.
capabilities.next_gate: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN gates 1-2: complete intake coverage and 20 consecutive correctly filed documents. Blocked on a browser-session route for the 415 blank envelopes; the API route cannot reach them.

capabilities.system_of_record: Rezef currently builds a derived balanced ledger; SUMIT remains authoritative for official books.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Trial balance and balance sheet are deterministic derived views, not proof of official immutable posting, period close or parity with SUMIT books. An approval-bound SUMIT createbatch adapter exists and persists provider acceptance, but it intentionally remains executed_unverified because the published API has no batch readback or close endpoint.
capabilities.next_gate: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN gate 3: portal-backed posting evidence, reversals and owner-approved close.

capabilities.system_of_record: Rezef owns match proposals and decisions; bank truth comes from Open Finance and document truth from SUMIT.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Matching and gap detection exist, but completeness depends on fresh bank and document sources; unsupported writeback must stay visible.
capabilities.next_gate: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN gate 4: zero prior-day unexplained movements for seven consecutive pilot days.

capabilities.system_of_record: SUMIT documents/payments are evidence; Rezef owns aging, tasks, collection cases and communication state.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Aging and collection workflows exist; legal escalation, payment execution and any communication without verified opt-in are outside autonomous operation.
capabilities.next_gate: Prove invoice-to-payment matching, action ownership and collections outcomes on the pilot month.

capabilities.system_of_record: Rezef prepares evidence-backed drafts; the authorized filing channel and authority acknowledgement are final.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Drafts and verification exist. A draft, an export, or a passing local calculation is never a filed return or authority acceptance.
capabilities.next_gate: MASTER_EXECUTION_PLAN gate 5: pilot pre-filing checklist passes and the VAT package is independently verified three ways.

capabilities.title_he: רווח והפסד, מאזן, תזרים ודוח בנק
capabilities.system_of_record: Rezef derives management views from normalized evidence and the derived ledger, with freshness and derivation labels.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Several reports are real and derived; legacy transaction-backed screens and forecasts cannot be promoted as current until their data plane is unified.
capabilities.next_gate: Make one canonical trial-balance-backed P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow package with freshness and reconciliation evidence.

capabilities.title_he: מנהל כספים — תזרים, תקציב, KPI והחלטות
capabilities.system_of_record: Rezef owns decision support, scenarios, tasks and snapshots; every number retains source and as-of metadata.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Decision support exists, but stale transaction-backed forecasts and illustrative AI output are not management truth.
capabilities.next_gate: Complete the pilot management pack: 13-week cash forecast, budget variance, debt plan and evidence-linked action list.

capabilities.system_of_record: The external provider or authority records the effect; Rezef records proposal, approval, execution and verification evidence.
capabilities.honest_boundary: Owner/signatory authority is separate from RBAC, scoped per action and cannot be bypassed by super-admin. The Open Finance create-payment adapter consumes the persisted payload, claims once and stores readback in offline tests. The SUMIT createbatch adapter follows the same immutable-intent and execute-once control plane but stops honestly at executed_unverified because SUMIT exposes no batch readback/close API. No live provider behavior is claimed, and refund, cancellation, mandate, filing and close adapters are not yet wired.
capabilities.next_gate: Bootstrap an explicitly verified owner for each existing organization, then wire and prove the remaining irreversible action types one by one.

capabilities.system_of_record: Rezef owns the conversation, the persona routing and the channel identity binding; every number in a reply comes from the same org-scoped services the web app uses, never from the model's memory.
capabilities.honest_boundary: מושקו קולט קבלות מצילום, עונה מנתוני המערכת בלבד ופועל דרך ווב, Telegram ו-WhatsApp בקוד שנבדק אופליין. מסך הווב נגיש גם ב-/agent/{session_id}; ה-session מסונן תמיד לפי ארגון ומשתמש, וסופר-אדמין מנהל תמלולים רוחביים רק במסך הניטור הנפרד. כל קריאת LLM וכלי נרשמת best-effort עם tenant scope; עלות נשארת NULL כשאין מחיר מדויק בקונפיג, וארגומנטים רגישים מחוטאים. תמלולים וטלמטריה רוחבית זמינים רק ל-SUPER_ADMIN. זיכרון לומד ניתן לניהול אנושי עם אישור ו-AuditLog; מנהל ארגון רואה רק עובדות עסק משותפות ואת הזיכרון האישי שלו, בעוד SUPER_ADMIN יכול לבצע ביקורת רוחבית. פעולת כתיבה נשמרת כ-pending_action; אישור מבצע claim אטומי לפני הכלי, ביטול נשמר במסד בכל שלושת הערוצים, ותוצאה חיצונית עמומה ננעלת כ-unknown ולא מורצת שוב אוטומטית. שלושת כלי המשימות משתמשים בטבלת Task הקיימת ומבודדים לארגון. ה-KB המקצועי מוצג לקריאה בלבד ומחזיר unavailable מפורש כשמסמכי docs אינם ארוזים. דחיפה יזומה מכבדת opt-in, תצורה פר-provider וחלון שירות WhatsApp בן 24 שעות; מחוץ לחלון אין ניסיון free-form, ובהיעדר תבנית מאושרת מוחזר outside_service_window. פרסונה אינה הרשאה וכל כתיבה נעצרת לאישור מפורש. הגבול החד: **רצף אינו משדר לרשות המסים** — propose_vat_filing_approval מתעד אישור למספרים בלבד והשידור ידני ב-SUMIT. שום התנהגות ספק חיה, תבנית Meta מאושרת, אריזת docs או פריסת הקוד החדש בפרוד אינה מוכחת כאן; קול לא נבנה.
capabilities.next_gate: פעולת בעלים בשער 0: אישור deploy של Alembic head d2e3f4a5b6c7 לפי runbook, כולל backfill חברות מאומת ו-CheckConstraint; הגדרת מחירי מודלים מדויקים ב-LLM_PRICING_JSON, סודות Telegram/WhatsApp, אימות אריזת docs ותבנית Meta מאושרת אופציונלית; לאחר מכן smoke חי מאושר שמוכיח בחירת ארגון, webhook, שיחה, claim/confirm/cancel, usage, tool-call, זיכרון, משימה ודחיפה בכל ערוץ בלי לעקוף את חלון השירות.
